evidence: Cato Agr. 37: per hiemem lūcubrātiōne haec facitō
Sen. Ep. 104.24: multa per noctem habita terrōrī
terms.comment: For what goes on through the time.

terms.grammar: construction: the time in the ablative, with no preposition
evidence: Mart. 10.62.12: aestāte puerī sī valent, satis discunt
Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.3: locum aestāte umbrōsiōrem
terms.comment: The plain answer to “when?”: hieme, aestāte, nocte, eō diē; “by night” is noctū.

terms.gloss: during (a meal, a game, an activity)
terms.grammar: preposition with the accusative, often of a gerund
evidence: Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.19: haec inter cēnam Tīrōnī dictāvī

terms.comment: in itinere, on the way; in convīviō, at a party.

phrases.english: do these jobs by lamplight during the winter

phrases.latin: multa per noctem habita terrōrī diēs vertit ad rīsum
phrases.english: much that frightened us during the night, the day turns into a laugh

phrases.latin: aestāte puerī sī valent, satis discunt
phrases.english: in summer, if children are well, they learn enough

phrases.latin: haec inter cēnam Tīrōnī dictāvī, nē mīrēre aliā manū esse
phrases.english: I dictated this to Tiro during dinner, so don’t be surprised that it is in another hand

phrases.latin: mōrēs quoque sē inter lūdendum simplicius dētegunt
phrases.english: character, too, shows itself more openly during play

phrases.latin: et narrābis ea fīliīs tuīs, et meditāberis in eīs sedēns in domō tuā, et ambulāns in itinere, dormiēns atque cōnsurgēns
phrases.english: and you shall tell them to your children, and think on them as you sit in your house and as you walk on the way, as you lie down and as you rise

sources: Lewis & Short: per · Lewis & Short: ablativus · Lewis & Short: inter · Lewis & Short: in
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-cato, loci-seneca-epistulae, loci-martialis, loci-cicero-epistulae, loci-quintilianus, loci-vulgata), checked against the editions named there.
Cicero’s letter to Quintus (3.1.19) is quoted as the loci collection gives it; the Perseus text reads hoc for haec.
